# Throiy Chess

> Opening traps, mating patterns and top games, explained fast. Short chess lessons (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook) about opening traps, how to avoid them, named mating patterns, and key moments from recent top-level games.

## Trap lessons
- [Scholar's Mate](https://throiychess.com/traps/scholars-mate/): Queen and bishop gang up on f7. Mate in four moves, unless you defend first. Opening: King's Pawn Opening. Moves: e4 e5 Bc4 Nc6 Qh5 Nf6 Qxf7#
- [Légal's Mate](https://throiychess.com/traps/legals-mate/): White gives away the queen and mates in two. Almost 300 years old, and it still works. Opening: Philidor Defense. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 d6 Bc4 Bg4 Nc3 g6 Nxe5 Bxd1 Bxf7+ Ke7 Nd5#
- [Fried Liver Attack](https://throiychess.com/traps/fried-liver-attack/): White gives up a knight on f7 and drags Black's king into the middle of the board. Opening: Italian Game. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5 d5 exd5 Nxd5 Nxf7 Kxf7 Qf3+ Ke6 Nc3
- [Fishing Pole Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/fishing-pole-trap/): Black leaves a knight hanging on g4. Take it, and the h-file opens straight onto your king. Opening: Ruy Lopez. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5 hxg4 hxg4 Nh2 Qh4 f3 g3 Rf2 Nd4 Kf1 gxh2 Ke1 h1=Q+ Bf1 Qxf1+ Kxf1 Qh1#
- [Petrov Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/petrov-trap/): Copy White's moves in the Petrov and one knight jump wins your queen. Opening: Petrov Defense. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nxe4 Qe2 Nf6 Nc6+ Qe7 Nxe7 Bxe7
- [Blackburne Shilling Gambit](https://throiychess.com/traps/blackburne-shilling-gambit/): Black hangs a pawn on purpose. Grab it, get greedy, and it's mate on move seven. Opening: Italian Game. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nd4 Nxe5 Qg5 Nxf7 Qxg2 Rf1 Qxe4+ Be2 Nf3#
- [Stafford Gambit](https://throiychess.com/traps/stafford-gambit/): Black gives away the queen on purpose. Take it, and it's mate in two. Opening: Petrov Defense. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nc6 Nxc6 dxc6 d3 Bc5 Bg5 Nxe4 Bxd8 Bxf2+ Ke2 Bg4#
- [Halloween Gambit](https://throiychess.com/traps/halloween-gambit/): White gives away a knight on move four. Scary? Not if you know the one safe square. Opening: Four Knights Game. Moves: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Nc3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nxe5 d4 Ng6 e5 Ng8 Bc4 d5 Bxd5 N8e7
- [Englund Gambit](https://throiychess.com/traps/englund-gambit/): Black gives a pawn on move one. Chase the queen the wrong way and it's mate on your back rank. Opening: Englund Gambit. Moves: d4 e5 dxe5 Nc6 Nf3 Qe7 Bf4 Qb4+ Bd2 Qxb2 Bc3 Bb4 Qd2 Bxc3 Qxc3 Qc1#
- [Elephant Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/elephant-trap/): The d5 pawn looks free. Grab it and you lose a whole piece. Opening: Queen's Gambit Declined. Moves: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Nbd7 cxd5 exd5 Nxd5 Nxd5 Bxd8 Bb4+ Qd2 Bxd2+ Kxd2 Kxd8
- [Lasker Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/lasker-trap/): A pawn marches all the way and turns into a knight, with check. Opening: Albin Counter-Gambit. Moves: d4 d5 c4 e5 dxe5 d4 e3 Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 Bxb4 exf2+ Ke2 fxg1=N+
- [Siberian Trap](https://throiychess.com/traps/siberian-trap/): Queen and knight aim at h2. Kick the knight and it's mate in two. Opening: Smith-Morra Gambit. Moves: e4 c5 d4 cxd4 c3 dxc3 Nxc3 Nc6 Nf3 e6 Bc4 Qc7 O-O Nf6 Qe2 Ng4 h3 Nd4 Nxd4 Qh2#

## Videos
- [All Shorts](https://throiychess.com/shorts/)
- [Hikaru missed this! Caruana vs Nakamura](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/c_eePbKneB0): Hikaru Nakamura had one winning move against Caruana at Clutch Chess, day 1. He grabbed a pawn instead, one check forced a rook trade, and the game ended in a draw.
- [One pawn wins a piece! Pragg vs Caruana](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iGouExzdMWs): Best move of Clutch Chess, day 1. Pragg offered a queen trade. Caruana said no and pushed one pawn: take the queen and the pawn takes the rook with check, save the rook and it queens anyway. Black ends up a full piece ah
- [Sounds English? It's Swedish. The Englund Gambit](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dt8ljwSUCOM): While England celebrates Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or, here's an opening that only sounds English.
- [Free queen? Mate in 2! Légal's Mate](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/paGdwe1cYmk): White gives away the queen and mates in two moves. The fix: don't grab the queen, take the knight instead.
- [Free rook? Don't take it! Giri vs Abdusattorov](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fJiePOSCU9I): Giri left his rook hanging on purpose. Abdusattorov took it, and White's attack crashed through. Before you grab something, check what your opponent gets.
- [Take my queen! The Stafford Gambit trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/TsHaDaBUS-c): Black gives away the queen on purpose. Take it and it's mate in two. The fix: don't pin the knight, just develop and castle.
- [Don't take the bait! The Fishing Pole Trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/G2pqyA0mXF0): Black leaves a knight on g4 as bait. Take it and the h-file opens straight at your king, ending in mate on h1.
- [Fried Liver Attack: mate in 9 (and how to stop it)](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WFRx-dXjOcc): White sacrifices a knight to drag Black's king into the open. The fix: don't take back in the center, attack the bishop instead.
- [Don't fall for this Petrov trap](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/KA_x11CO7Gg): Copying White's moves costs Black the queen. The fix: kick the knight away first, then take back the pawn.
- [Stop the Scholar's Mate (and punish it)](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LCSXV_yJs_U): Queen and bishop attack one weak square next to your king. Block the queen first, then make her run.
- [He moved his king on move 5… big mistake](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/9EOJdMBaPO4): No castling, a knight fork on f7 and a rook gone. In the opening, castle; don't move your king by hand.
- [I fell for the oldest trick in chess](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xF6KVwnOGCY): Queen and bishop against f7. Once they aim at f7, keep defending it.
- [10 Opening Traps Every Beginner Must Know](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SU-9w7C9I3g): 10 opening traps every beginner must know, from Scholar's Mate to the Siberian Trap. For each trap you see the setup, the bait, how it punishes you, and the fix so you never fall for it. Every line checked with Stockfish
